Chronological Bible Storying

An oral methodology for communicating God’s Word through His stories.

About Bible Storying

Sharing God's Redemption Story, One Chronological Step at a Time.

Chronological Bible storytelling is one of the exciting tools being used throughout the world these days in planting churches among unreached people groups. Chronological Bible story teaching began with New Tribes Missions as they worked among tribal groups in the Philippines.

Read More

What We've Achieved

Expanding the Reach of the Gospel Through Bible Storying

We have trained hundreds of pastors in Chronological Bible Storying, equipping them with the tools to share the gospel effectively. Through this simple yet powerful method, we have witnessed pastors and churches transformed by the message of the Bible, leading to hundreds of lives coming to Christ.
